workingDays.note: No public holidays applied; none are recorded in the docs for the forecast window.

phases.name: Build
phases.note: start = first day of the story-points record (hub chart, from 2026-10-28), not a documented kickoff; the shell, Landing Page and the pre-OFA Advisor Dashboard were built and released earlier as functional mocks (2026-10-12). Build includes OFA-F-028 Go-live and OFA-F-029 coverage gate (PS Phase 5), and OFA-F-030 in eSignatureWebAPI (outside this repo).

phases.name: Deployment
phases.status: Not started: only the functional mocks are deployed
phases.note: The releases in docs/releases.md (2026-10-12, updates 1-2 2026-10-12, update 3 2026-10-14, update 4 2026-10-27, Advisor Dashboard 0.14.0) were labelled Alpha but are functional mocks: the artboards with surface-level behaviour to show look and feel, no backend. The product itself has not been deployed. OFA go-live is OFA-F-028 (Planned). No deployment date in any doc.

phases.name: Acceptance Testing
phases.note: No acceptance-testing phase, UAT plan or date is recorded in docs/deployment, the PMBooks, PRDs or handoffs. Manual verification has been waived by Muhammed since 2026-11-11 (hub note).

velocity.window: last 10 working days (2026-11-02 to 2026-11-13), plus the weekend points of 2026-11-14
velocity.seriesNote: The daily record starts on 2026-10-28, so it leaves out 53 points: 46 finished before that date and 7 marked Done in the PMBooks with no date.

forecast.method: optimistic = last-10-working-day rate; likely = mean of the two rates; pessimistic = whole-period rate (since 2026-10-28). Working days Mon-Fri; weekend points count in the totals but weekends are never counted as days.

overall.basis: critical path: the latest component date (Portfolio Services); pooled-rate dates would be 2026-11-26 / 2026-11-26 / 2026-11-27. OFA work only: Plugin0 (the component library) is left out, finished and remaining.

milestones.name: Branch split: one checkout per OFA component

sources.file: docs/<component>/project-management.md (+ archive/*/project-management.md); advisor, PS, compliance from their branch checkouts, shell/landing-page from the hub checkout

seriesNote: The daily record starts on 2026-10-28, so it leaves out 38 points finished before that date. Plugin0 (the component library) is not OFA work and is left out of every figure.
